changes.to: Issue #17 (2026-11-17): Hexagon AEON - 165 cm, 60 kg, 34 DoF, 2.4 m/s, 8 kg constant carry (15 kg short-term), 5 h per charge with 1-minute self battery swap. [replaced payload_kg: 15 -> 8; runtime_h: 4.0 -> 5.0]

Maker spec sheet (robotics.hexagon.com/product): top speed 2.4 m/s, mass 60 kg, height 165 cm, 34 DoF, payload 15 kg short-term / 8 kg constant carry, 5 h autonomous work per charge with a 1-minute self-swap (record had 4 h, corrected to 5 h). Locomotion is wheel-legged: each leg ends in a foot-wheel that locks for stairs, so 'Wheeled' was corrected to 'Wheel-legged'. Launched 17 Jun 2025; pilots with Schaeffler, Pilatus and BMW (Leipzig). No price published.

changes.from: Wheeled (bimanual torso on a wheeled base) humanoid from Hexagon Robotics; b2b only, sold to businesses.
changes.to: Hexagon's industrial humanoid on legs with foot-wheels: 34 DoF, 60 kg, 2.4 m/s and a one-minute self-swapping battery for continuous work.
